delivery.description: The delivery ULID. Matches X-Tmesis-Delivery. Duplicated in the body so a receiver that logs bodies has the dedupe key without the headers.

occurred_at.description: RFC3339 UTC, when the event happened on the node. ORDER BY THIS, never by arrival: delivery is unordered.

stream.description: The stream id parsed out of the key. null when the key was too malformed to parse one.

reason.description: CLOSED set: every reason this event can carry, which is what both ingest listeners refuse a publish with. It is NOT the tmesis_publish_rejected_total label set: internal, panic and encrypted are counted there and never emitted here. closed is a node draining in place (admission closed). encoder_unavailable is a node whose pinned live encoder (encode.video_encoder) failed at boot: SRT 1503, RTMP Publish failed. over_capacity is a node whose stored live capacity, told limits.max_streams, or NVENC/QSV device session ceiling has no room for this publish: SRT 1402, RTMP Publish failed. over_capacity and encoder_unavailable are never rate-limited for a locally proven key (signed, or a configured bare key): every such refusal is a delivery and a timeline row. An unproven token's refusal under the OPEN posture, and every other reason, stays under publish_rejected_per_minute and the node-wide ceiling.

key_fragment.description: Redacted: the stream id and epoch in full, then the first four and last four hex characters of the MAC with three dots between.
